hypothesis: H6: at fixed M the RMSE of rho_hat grows like e^{2t} and that of the fitted excess kurtosis like e^{4t} with the observation level t beyond t_*; their ratio like e^{2t}
design: Laplace chain, M = 512 sequences all observed at one level t in (0.05,0.1,0.2,0.4,0.7,1.0,1.4,2.0) plus the clean arm (t = 0), C = 8, EM ladder (10..400) selected on a same-level validation bundle (bulk), 16 seeds; records fitted rho/variance/kurtosis, Hellinger to the truth, and the twelve-level test risk
predeclared_analysis: tools/make_learning_numbers.py: RMSE over seeds per level of rho_hat and kurt_hat (about the true 0.85 and 3.0); OLS log-slope of RMSE vs t over levels t >= 1.0; ratio slope; the clean arm as the floor
